description: Lists the e-invoice formats this server can check or create: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, EN 16931, Romanian e-Factura (CIUS-RO) and Polish KSeF FA(3), with the validators and rule-set versions used and the input size limits. Fits questions about supported formats, versions and limits. Does not check a file (validate_einvoice does).
name: list_supported_formats
